subject: Inviting Fieldfare to co-present an Implementation Showcase webinar
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Brooks <samantha@fieldfarehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fieldfare + Redwood: co-hosted implementation showcase?

Hi Samantha,

Hope you had a good week. We loved the notes you shared about Fieldfare's rollout timeline last quarter — the outcomes on latency and cost per inference were particularly compelling. A quick outreach: the customer marketing team and I are planning a short-format "Implementation Showcase" webinar series in late January that highlights deep-dive technical lessons from customers (20–30 minute talk + 10 minute Q&A).

Would Fieldfare be open to co-presenting? High-level format we're proposing:
- 20 minute case study: architecture, rollout decisions, and measured impact
- 10 minute demo of a critical integration (e.g., private deployment or autoscaling policy)
- 10 minute live Q&A

We can cover speaker logistics, travel (if in-person), and a short prep call. If this is interesting I can loop in Marissa (customer marketing) to work the agenda and comms.

Attaching a draft agenda and our standard speaker brief for context. No hard commitment — just checking interest first.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments:
- draft-agenda.pdf (3 pages)
- fieldfare-logo.png (sticker)
From: Samantha Brooks <samantha@fieldfarehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Holloway <ben.holloway@fieldfarehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fieldfare + Redwood: co-hosted implementation showcase?

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the invite — this sounds great and timely. Ben and I discussed briefly and we're interested in participating. A couple of quick notes:
- We'd prefer a 30 minute format (18–20 minute talk + 12 min Q&A) to leave room for a few customer questions.
- Our compliance team will need to sign off on slides that show telemetry/metrics; are you ok with redacting specific PII-sensitive IDs?
- Can we target Wednesday, Jan 21 or Thursday, Jan 22 for a live session (PST morning)?

Please loop Marissa for scheduling and logistics; Ben will be the primary presenter with me joining for the Q&A.

Best,
Samantha Brooks
Director of Platform | Fieldfare Health
Samantha.Brooks@fieldfarehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Brooks <samantha@fieldfarehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fieldfare + Redwood: co-hosted implementation showcase?

Hi Samantha — so glad you and Ben are interested. Quick next steps from our side:

1) Confirm date: Jan 21 (Wed) 10:00–10:45 PT — does that work for Ben?
2) Speaker logistics: 20 minute talk + 12 minute live Q&A. We'll moderate and collect questions.
3) Compliance/Slides: yes, we can accept redacted telemetry. Please send the slide deck at least 72 hours prior so our legal/comms folks can review.
4) Pre-call: propose a 30–40 minute prep run on Jan 14 or Jan 15.

I attached a slightly refreshed draft agenda and our speaker brief (short checklist). Also including Zoom + recording consent language to review.

Could you confirm the presenter name, headshot, and a 2–3 sentence bio by EOD Friday? We’ll also send a speaker agreement link (DocuSign) for standard permissions.

Thanks — looking forward to this.
Marissa
Senior Manager, Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments:
- draft-agenda.pdf (v2, 2 pages)
- speaker-brief.pdf (1 page)
From: Samantha Brooks <samantha@fieldfarehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fieldfare + Redwood: co-hosted implementation showcase?

Marissa / Karthik — confirmed. Ben Holloway will present; dates and timing look good. Action items from our side:
- Ben's bio + headshot attached (will send separate email with files)
- We'll send an initial slide deck with redacted metrics by Jan 10 for review.
- Agree to recording and consent language; we'll complete the DocuSign once received.

Ben — copying you to confirm you can present on Jan 21 at 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Samantha
